critique.good: The technical core (符号 · 公式 · 单位) stays adjacent and compact, so a reader can scan symbol → formula → unit without eye travel; 说明 is clearly the annotation column and the overall column order matches reading order.
critique.problems: Three of five headers break (物理/量, 符/号, 单/位), which makes the header band look taller and ragged than the body, and it competes with the body for attention. 物理量 names like 理想气体状态方程 shatter into four short lines, so the row entry point — the thing the eye lands on first — is the least readable cell. 说明 is so narrow that 'G ≈ 6.674×10⁻¹¹' breaks after the ≈, splitting the constant from its value and destroying the note's lookup value.
critique.cause: Col 1 at 54px gives only 33px of text = two CJK characters per line, so 3-character header 物理量 and 8-character names cannot hold a line. Cols 2 and 4 at 51px give 30px, one pixel short of the 31px one-line header width, so 符号 and 单位 wrap. 说明 at 98px gives 77px… minus rounding, so the 77px token 6.674×10⁻¹¹ spills. Only 公式 at 105 (84px text) is generously sized, and it still can't hold 'E_k = ½mv²' (91px) on one line — width spent where it does least good.

critique.good: 物理量 now holds its header on one line and row names read in three lines instead of four, so the left edge is much calmer; 公式 at 86px is still wide enough that no formula token (65px 'G·m₁m₂/r²') is ever split.
critique.problems: 符号 and 单位 still break into vertical 符/号 and 单/位 stacks, which reads as two skinny columns of noise next to the healthy 公式 column. 说明 remains the weak point: the constant still breaks after ≈ and the note cells are the tallest in every row, driving row height to 83–106px.
critique.cause: Cols 2 and 4 were kept at 51px, one pixel under the 52px needed for a 31px header. The 19px freed from 公式 was given to col 1 (73px) rather than to 说明, so the column that actually wraps prose was left at 98px.

critique.good: Best of the three: 说明 at 127px finally lets 'G ≈ 6.674×10⁻¹¹' and 'N·m²/kg²' sit on single lines, notes read as sentences rather than confetti, and row 3 (pv = nRT, 60px) is visibly tighter than in A/B — the whole table drops to 368px. 公式 at 86px keeps every token intact.
critique.problems: 符号 and 单位 are now the worst columns in the table: at 40px they are narrow strips with vertical header stacks and single glyphs floating in white space, out of proportion to everything else and visually louder than their content deserves. 物理量 wraps again (物理/量) and names still take four lines.
critique.cause: 40px leaves only 19px of text, barely one CJK glyph, so both headers must stack. The width taken from 符号/单位 was spent entirely on 说明, overshooting: 说明 only needed ~98px to keep its longest token whole, and the surplus came out of the two columns that had the least to spare.

critique.good: 说明 at 103px is the most generous of the three, so the constant line (G ≈ 6.674×10⁻¹¹ / N·m²/kg²) and the R note breathe, and the 符号/单位 columns are comfortable.
critique.problems: The formula column — the reason this table exists — is broken: row 1 reads 'E_k =' then '½mv²', row 2 reads 'F =' then 'G·m₁m₂/r²', so the eye must stitch each formula back together. The 物理量 header splits as 物理/量, which reads like two words, and the label column stacks 万有引力 and 理想气体状态方程 into 4 lines, making row 3 the tallest cell at 106px.
critique.cause: col3=86 leaves only 65px of text, about 4–5px short of holding 'E_k = ½mv²' whole; col1=66 leaves 45px, just under the ~46px that 物理量 needs, so the header wraps and body names drop to 2 characters per line.

critique.good: The best of the three: col3=90 is the first width at which 'E_k = ½mv²' stays on one line, so every formula is now readable as a unit; 说明 at 99 keeps the 77px token 6.674×10⁻¹¹ unbroken, which is the hard floor for that column.
critique.problems: The 物理量 header still splits (物理/量), and 理想气体状态方程 still runs to 4 lines, so the label column is the tallest thing in row 3 and drives the 106px row. The 2px sitting in 符号 and 单位 (52) do nothing — those cells hold 16px of content.
critique.cause: col1=66 is 1–3px short of the 3-character header width; the spare budget went to col2/col4, which were already satisfied at 51.

critique.good: 说明 at 99 and a balanced look; the table scans cleanly row to row and no token is split mid-word.
critique.problems: This is the most misallocated of the three: 符号 and 单位 grew to 54 while 公式 fell back to 86, re-breaking 'E_k = ½mv²' into 'E_k =' / '½mv²'. The two columns that gained pixels have no use for them, and the one column that needed them lost them. 物理量 still wraps.
critique.cause: 4px moved from col3 into col2/col4, whose minimum is 51 (header 符号/单位 = 30px + 21px padding); col3 at 86 is below the ~90px threshold for the kinetic-energy formula.

critique.good: The 公式 column at 90px is wide enough that every formula (E_k = ½mv², F = G·m₁m₂/r², pV = nRT, E = mc²) stays on one line with tokens intact — the core reference value of the table survives. 说明 at 98px is exactly the minimum for the 77px unbreakable strings (6.674×10⁻¹¹, J/(mol·K)), so nothing in the notes splits mid-token. 物理量 at 69px keeps its own header on one line and breaks names into tidy 3-character stacks.
critique.problems: The header band is ragged: 符号 and 单位 stack as 符/号 and 单/位 (2 lines) while 物理量, 公式 and 说明 sit on one line, so the header row is visually uneven and the top of every row looks misaligned. Col 1 also holds 2px more than it needs — its content wrapping is identical at 67px — while col 3 sits right at the fit threshold.
critique.cause: col2 and col4 were set to 51px, 1px short of the 31px header + 21px chrome (52px) needed for a two-character header; the 2px is wasted in col1 (69px vs the 67px that still fits 物理量 on one line).

critique.good: Giving 物理量 82px (61px of text) lets 理想气体状态方程 break into two lines instead of three, so the row-entry column reads as a phrase rather than a vertical stack.
critique.problems: This is the worst of the three: the 公式 column is shredded — formulas wrap to two lines and one token splits mid-word (G·m₁m₂/… /r²), so the defining formula, the very thing the table exists for, can no longer be read as a unit. The 说明 column is unchanged (still 4 lines, still the row-height driver), so nothing was actually gained for the space taken.
critique.cause: col3 was cut to 77px (56px of text) which is below the 86px needed to hold the longest unbreakable token (65px) — the 5px taken from the formula column were simply too few to help 物理量 and far too many for the formulas.

critique.good: The most generous 公式 column (93px) — all four formulas sit comfortably on one line with clear breathing room, and 说明 keeps its 98px minimum.
critique.problems: Three of five headers now wrap (物理量, 符号, 单位), making the header band visibly ragged and taller; and 物理量 at 66px crushes 理想气体状态方程 into a three-line vertical stack while adding nothing to the formula column, which already fit at 90.
critique.cause: col1 at 66px leaves 45px of text, 1px below what 物理量 (3 characters) needs, so the header wraps; the 3px moved into col3 (90→93) buys no legibility that 90px did not already have.

understanding.purpose: A compact physics formula reference: for each quantity it gives the symbol, defining formula, unit and a short explanatory note, for lookup and quick comparison rather than continuous reading.
understanding.reading: Readers scan row by row: quantity name → symbol → formula → unit, then drop into the note. Columns 2–4 form a compact technical core, while 说明 is secondary but contains constants and caveats that must remain legible.
groups: Columns 2 符号, 3 公式 and 4 单位 belong together: they are the technical identity of each quantity and should stay adjacent and compact.
Column 1 物理量 is the row entry point and label.
Column 5 说明 is explanatory annotation and can absorb wrapping.
keep_intact: symbols such as E_k, F, E
formula tokens and operators; ideally whole formulas, at minimum unbreakable terms such as ½mv² and G·m₁m₂/r²
short headers 符号, 公式, 单位
may_wrap: 物理量 names such as 理想气体状态方程
formulas at = or spaces if necessary, but not inside tokens

bad.why: 公式列仅 77px，正文只剩 56px，小于 65px 的不可断词 G·m₁m₂/r²，导致 r² 被拆到下一行；公式被拆断，读者容易误读。

final.rationale: r3A 是唯一让 5 个表头全部单行显示的方案，同时没有公式或单位串被拆断，因此表格高度从 392px 降到 368px。它把第一列压到 67px 的临界值，把说明列压到 98px 的临界值，正好保住“物理量”和 77px 的长数字/单位串，同时把省下的宽度给公式列。其余方案大多只多包了一个“物理量”表头，仍可发布；r2B 则越过了公式列的不可断词下限，属于明确错误。

general: 列宽应由最长不可断词和列的角色决定，而不是平均分配或追求对称。
表头也是内容：短表头只差 1px 就可能换行，并让整行高度翻倍。
公式、编号、数字和单位串必须整块保留；说明性文字可以换行吸收剩余宽度。
在窄屏表格里，消除表头换行往往比给说明列多几像素空白更能改善整体节奏。
specific: 说明列至少要 98px，才能容纳 77px 的 6.674×10⁻¹¹ / J/(mol·K) 类串。
公式列至少 86px，才能让 G·m₁m₂/r² 不被拆开；90px 已足够，继续加宽不会减少行数。
符号列和单位列 52px 正好容纳 31px 的双字表头，低于 52px 会把“符号”“单位”拆成单字。
第一列 67px 是“物理量”单行显示的下限，r3A 正是靠这一点取得 0/5 表头换行。

final.tradeoffs: 可以争论的是：把更多宽度给说明列（如 r1A 的 103px）换取更松的阅读感，是否比 r3A 消除“物理量”表头换行更重要；另一派则愿意接受 r2A/r2C 把“符号”“单位”竖排，以换取正文列宽。
final.uncertain: 双字表头竖排（r2A/r2C）在正式出版物中是否可接受，取决于刊物对表头整齐度的要求；此外，67px 的第一列对当前四行内容刚好，但换成更长的物理量名称时会很快变高。

A.why: Every column is squeezed at once: 符号 and 单位 headers stack as 符/号 and 单/位, the first formula breaks after '=' (E_k = / ½mv²), and 万有引力 splits. Nothing is broken mid-token and the description still reads in three clean lines, but no column gets the width its role deserves.

B.why: 符号 and 单位 headers stay on one line and E_k = ½mv² stays intact, but the primary 物理量 column is starved: its header stacks as 物理/量 and 理想气体状态方程 spills over four lines, which sets the row height for every row and makes the key column the hardest to scan.

C.why: The only layout where all five headers sit on one line, and the formula column is wide enough for E_k = ½mv² and pV = nRT. The squeeze is taken by 物理量 (2–3 lines per cell), which is the right place for it, and 说明 breaks at natural points (物体由于运/动而具有的/能量。). Good hierarchy and no broken identifiers.

D.why: The description column is starved: units and formulas fracture mid-token (N·m²/k / g², J/(mol· / K)。), the value 6.674× / 10⁻¹¹ splits across lines, and the formula column breaks E_k = / ½mv². Tall rows with lots of trapped white space and unreadable technical strings.

E.why: Like B, width is spent on 符号/单位 rather than the 物理量 column: the header stacks as 物理/量 and 理想气体状态方程 runs to four lines while 符号/单位 sit in relatively airy single-character cells. Readable, but the balance is on the wrong side.

F.why: The inverse trade-off: 说明 finally gets room (two lines, and G ≈ 6.674×10⁻¹¹ / N·m²/kg² breaks cleanly at the space), so the only running text reads best here. But it costs three stacked headers (物理/量, 符/号, 单/位) and four-line 物理量 cells, so the header row and the key column both look cramped.

reviews.unsure: Exact pixel widths are estimated from the render; I also can't tell whether stacked two-character CJK headers (符/号, 单/位) are acceptable in this design system — if they are, F becomes a serious contender for the best description legibility; if not, C is clearly ahead.

A.why: 说明列过窄，文字和数值被切成许多短行；公式也频繁换行，行高过大且难以横向比较。

B.why: 说明列较易阅读，物理量列也有一定空间；但符号和单位表头被拆成两行，万有引力公式分成多行。

C.why: 公式和说明列都有足够空间，多数公式保持完整；但物理量表头及较长名称被拆成多行。

D.why: 公式与说明的宽度分配较均衡，多数公式完整；物理量表头和长名称换行较多。

E.why: 说明列宽裕，数值和说明较容易阅读；但前三个窄列中有两个表头被拆开，长物理量名称也被切得很碎。

F.why: 所有表头保持单行，公式大多完整，说明也可读；较长物理量名称和部分说明仍需多行。

reviews.unsure: C 和 D 看起来非常相近，细微宽度差异及其对阅读的影响难以从图中可靠区分。
